policy-returns: Unworn items with the tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return at https://shop.example/returns.
policy-refunds: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return reaches our warehouse. Refunds cannot be sent to a different card or account.
policy-delivery: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Delivery is free for orders over 50 EUR. Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Track a parcel at https://shop.example/track.
